plain: The blue ramp is now the info ramp (same values, feedback only), and the Microsoft Game Dev project brand colours are gone.

steps.plain: Read tokenValues.primitive.color.info instead of tokenValues.primitive.color.blue; the values are the same.
Declare the Microsoft Game Dev brand colours in your own tenant tokens; HDS no longer ships them.
Read tokens.primitive.color.info instead of tokens.primitive.color.blue; the values are the same.
Declare the Microsoft Game Dev brand colours in your own tenant tokens; HDS no longer ships them.
Change var(--primitive-color-blue-<stop>) to var(--primitive-color-info-<stop>); the old names stay as aliases for one release and are removed in 0.49.0.
The --hds-accent-50 to --hds-accent-900 aliases now follow the accent ramp (graphite, or cobalt under data-accent) instead of blue; use --semantic-accent-* instead, as the aliases are deprecated.
